_comment: Authoritative per-account lifetime realized PnL (broker wallet-truth) for accounts whose live per-row journal pnl can't be trusted. Written by a reviewed scripts/ops/reconcile_netting_pnl.py --emit-ledger run from an operator-provided Bybit UM export. Surfaced read-only at GET /api/bot/pnl/broker-truth. Aggregates only (no positions/balances/keys) — same public class as the existing /performance realized surface. NOT a money-DB row rewrite: the journal per-row pnl is left as-is; this records the account-level truth next to it. See docs/audits/bybit2-broker-reconciliation-2026-07-13.md.

accounts.note: Wallet-truth (Bybit UM Change minus transfers), stitched across two sub-accounts (MAIN -1.52 + SUB -261.01). The account mixed spot+perp and switched sub-accounts on 2026-05-10, producing a conversion cohort that per-fill FIFO / per-row journal attribution can't resolve (perp TRADE gross was +768 vs this wallet-truth -262.52). This account-level figure is authoritative; the journal per-row pnl (~-33) under-records and is left unmodified.

declared_gaps.reason: The live API key belongs to the sub-account the bot trades (MAIN), not SUB. SUB history exists only in the operator's 2026-07-13 UM CSV export. It is CLOSED (see closed_evidence), so it is added to the live API figure in `current`, not refreshed.
declared_gaps.refresh: none needed: closed component. MAIN refreshes hourly via the transaction-log puller and is folded into `current` by src/runtime/broker_truth.current_wallet_truth.
declared_gaps.closed_evidence: LEDGER-REFRESH 2026-11-12: the SUB period was the bot trading on a different key (~2026-05-10..2026-06-28). The current key's transaction log (pulled hourly) has no rows 2026-05-01..2026-06-28 and rows on every trading day from 2026-06-29; over 2026-04-15..07-13 it reproduces this record's MAIN -1.52 to the cent. Every bybit_2 journal day with a fill since 2026-06-29 (90 of 90, in the newest 4000 journal rows) has a fee-bearing TRADE row under the current key. The trader and the puller use the same key env. So SUB -261.01 is a finished historical component. Not observable by this key: manual activity in SUB after 2026-06-28.
